acts.desc: Producer Ben Calhoun tells Ira about a secret move his friend uses all the time — the "good guy discount" — that gets Ben's friend money off all sorts of items when he's shopping.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Ben tries the good guy discount, to see if he can pull it off, as Ira tags along.
acts.title: Takes One To Know One

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Mike Birbiglia has this story about a time his good guy-ness was called into question.
acts.title: The Heels On The Bus

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Julia DeWitt tells the story of someone who goes to incredible lengths to do a favor for another guy, even though the guy won't ever be able to know about it. Julia's story originally aired on Snap Judgment.
acts.title: No Man Left Behind

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: In 2009, a U.S. soldier contacted our show and offered to send audio dispatches from his deployment in Afghanistan, to do a story about what it's really like to go to war. But what he learned when he was over there was way more personal and honest than we, or he, expected. Producer Sarah Koenig explains. Note: Ira warns listeners that this story may not be appropriate for children.
acts.title: The Deepest Darkest Open Secret
